name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

fee.note: USD list price; an eligible unused certification discount could reduce it to $75, but the benefit was not checked.

exam.format: 65 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 130 minutes, three-year validity; AWS recommends at least one year designing AWS solutions.

scope: Designing secure, resilient, high-performing and cost-optimized architectures on AWS.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.

discounts.text: After you earn an AWS Certification, AWS gives you a 50% discount voucher for recertification or any other AWS exam.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you wait 14 calendar days; there is no limit on attempts, but each one costs the full exam fee.
access.accommodations: Non-native English speakers taking the exam in English can request 30 extra minutes (ESL +30) once in their AWS Certification account; it then applies to every booking.

timeline.text: Last day for the Italian version of the exam.

domains_note: Weights from the AWS Certification Exam Guide (SAA-C03), the guide linked from the live SAA listing, read 2026-11-03.
